# Campaign Asia

> > Campaign Asia is the leading trade publication covering advertising, marketing, media, and public relations across the Asia-Pacific region.

Campaign Asia delivers news, analysis, and insights on brand campaigns, agency appointments, media planning, and industry trends across major markets including China, Hong Kong, Singapore, Thailand, Vietnam, and Australia. The publication serves marketing professionals with coverage of creative work, business developments, and thought leadership from industry experts.

## Key Topics

- Asia-Pacific marketing
- Media planning and buying
- Advertising sales
- Public relations
- Brand partnerships
- Regional sponsorship
- Agency appointments
- China market
- Hong Kong
- Singapore
- Thailand
- Vietnam
- Global marketing campaigns
- Creative advertising
- Industry trends
